items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think of John Pizzarelli in that vein. He’s found a niche there I think. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah and there’s a whole hipster thing starting to happen with Kurt Elling, Patricia Barber, people like that...

ctx.x: there’s some demographic now that’s significant and is accepting this as a part of their lifestyle.
I think of John Pizzarelli in that vein. He’s found a niche there I think.

Yeah and there’s a whole hipster thing starting to happen with Kurt Elling, Patricia Barber, people like that, that this melding of kind of a hipster appearance, a Hollywood kind of swinger’s look with jazz, that also could be an interesting trend for us.
